prose: Embo emerged from stealth announcing a $110M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Khosla Ventures, DST Global, NVIDIA and others, to build world models for robotics. The company says its robot brain pretrains on massive amounts of internet video to learn objects, physical interactions and how tasks unfold, then practices motor skills in imagined scenarios, and is finetuned on experience from its own humanoid fleet and post-trained with reinforcement learning. The founding team cites work on Dreamer, VideoGPT and Diffusion Forcing and experience at Google DeepMind, Meta Superintelligence Labs, NVIDIA Cosmos, UC Berkeley and MIT, plus infrastructure for training multimodal models across 70,000 GPUs. This is a company launch announcement: no benchmark, demo video or customer is shown, and the capability claims are unproven.
